messages:
Marin (People Ops): Quick check-in  Jordan's turning 30 next Friday (Jun 11). We're planning a tiny celebration during lunch. Please vote 1/2/3/4 and volunteer if you can help pack or order:
1) In-office bagel brunch (SF kitchen) + card
2) Boba delivery to remote folks + quick Zoom hangout
3) Pizza lunch and open mic (5-min shoutouts)
4) Small donation to Jordan's fave shelter + virtual cake emoji chain
Signup: https://tiny.redwood/jordan30 (pick an option and a task). I'll coordinate orders. @here

Jordan: lol no spoilers plz :sweat_smile: I'll be in-office that day but low-key is fine :)

Ravi: 2  boba pls. I'll help with delivery addresses for remote. :tumbler_glass:

Sofia: 1  bagels are my jam. I can grab cream cheese and labels (vegan option too).

Talia: 4  love donating. Any recs? I can handle the card signing round-robin.

Marin (People Ops): Great! Volunteers so far: Sofia (bagels/vegan), Ravi (boba logistics), Talia (card). Need someone for in-office setup (plates/napkins) or to handle pizza ordering if we go 3. Post in the signup link.

PeopleOpsBot: Event draft created  "Jordan 30"  Jun 11  12:00pm PT  Zoom link attached  RSVP: 5

Ravi: Also pls let me know if anyone's remote outside US time zones, i can stagger deliveries.

Sofia: Dietary notes: Jordan is pescatarian. Also check for gluten-free in case someone needs it. I can label items.

Marin (People Ops): Noted. Talia  any shelter recs?

Talia: There's a local animal shelter Jordan volunteers at (Paws & Partners). I can pull the donation link and suggested amounts tonight.

Jordan: this is very sweet you guys, thank you :blush: No pressure on presents, just your awful jokes at the open mic will do.

Marin (People Ops): Love that. Final ask: if you have a 5-10s clip or a silly photo with Jordan for a quick montage, DM me or drop here by Wed EOD. Otherwise we'll keep it simple.

Ravi: I'll DM a clip.

Sofia: I'll sign up to set table + clean up if it's the bagel option.

Marin (People Ops): Perfect, I'll post the confirmed plan by Wednesday morning once signup fills. Thanks everyone! :confetti_ball:
